Aaj Phir Jeene Ki Tamanna Hai | Guide (1965) | Evergreen Hindi Classic
Presenting the timeless and inspiring song “Aaj Phir Jeene Ki Tamanna Hai” from the legendary Bollywood film Guide (1965). Featuring the iconic on-screen pair of Dev Anand and Waheeda Rehman, this song beautifully captures the spirit of hope, freedom, and the joy of living.
Sung soulfully by Lata Mangeshkar, with meaningful lyrics penned by Shailendra and unforgettable music composed by S.D. Burman, this evergreen melody remains one of the most cherished inspirational songs in the history of Hindi cinema.
